title: 美国年轻世代转向多元收入来源
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: The outlook for Gen Z is pretty grim.
They're struggling to find well-paying jobs while inflation continues to rise, so they're seeking out alternatives to the traditional 9-5.
segments.zh: 他们难以找到高薪工作，同时通胀持续上升，因此他们正在寻找传统朝九晚五之外的替代方案。

segments.en: Income stacking really comes from this idea that in the modern economy, one income is just no longer enough for people.
segments.zh: 收入叠加源于这样一个理念：在现代经济中，单一收入对人们来说已不再足够。

segments.en: This one does a lot of business.
It's like five grand a month. Their hands may have been forced by the increasingly uncertain U.S. economy, but it's giving rise to many creative solutions.
segments.zh: 每月大概五千美元。他们可能迫于日益不确定的美国经济形势，但这催生了许多创造性的解决方案。

segments.en: It's easy to come across the videos.
Influencers hawk their methods to make money in an era of poor job prospects.
segments.zh: 在就业前景不佳的时代，网红们兜售他们的赚钱方法。

segments.en: Why are you not making an extra $2,000, $3,000, $4,000 a month online with all of the side hustles that are available right now?
segments.zh: 现在有这么多副业机会，你为什么不每月在网上多赚2000、3000、4000美元呢？

segments.en: I made over $1.5 million last year from seven different income streams.
segments.zh: 去年我从七个不同的收入来源赚了超过150万美元。

segments.en: Gen Z, which are people that were born between 1997 and 2012, are increasingly disillusioned with the job market.
segments.zh: Z世代，即1997年至2012年出生的人，对就业市场越来越失望。

segments.en: One example is 24-year-old Micah Stanley, who opted out of a traditional 9-5 for a vending machine business, that he has since expanded into multiple income streams.
segments.zh: 24岁的Micah Stanley就是一个例子，他放弃了传统的朝九晚五，转做自动售货机生意，如今已拓展出多个收入来源。

segments.en: As a member of Gen Z myself, I think that I've definitely fallen into scrolling on the Internet and comparing myself to all these other Gen Z years.
segments.zh: 作为Z世代的一员，我觉得自己肯定也陷入了刷手机、跟其他Z世代比较的循环。

segments.en: If you go on Instagram, all these kids are flexing their Lamborghini SVJs and Miami.
segments.zh: 如果你上Instagram，那些年轻人都在晒兰博基尼SVJ和迈阿密。
